description: Notification sent to instructors when they are assigned to supervise an exam
subject: Exam Scheduled (Instructor): $module_code - $module_name
body:
Dear $instructor_name,

You have been assigned as the instructor for the following exam:

Module: $module_code - $module_name
Date: $exam_date
Time: $start_time - $end_time
Room: $room
Number of Students: $students_enrolled

Please ensure you are available to supervise this examination.

Best regards,
University Examination Office
